mainEntity.name: What is a laser marking machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: A laser marking machine uses a focused laser beam to create permanent or durable marks on compatible materials. It can be used for text, logos, serial numbers, barcodes, QR codes, graphics, and product identification.

mainEntity.name: What is a laser marking machine used for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laser marking machines are used for product identification, serial numbers, QR codes, barcodes, logos, batch numbers, manufacturing dates, traceability, branding, and decorative marking.

mainEntity.name: Which laser marking machine is best for metal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber laser marking machines are widely used for marking compatible metals such as stainless steel, aluminium, brass, copper, titanium, and other metal components. The best machine depends on the exact material and required marking result.

mainEntity.name: Can a laser marking machine mark QR codes and barcodes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Suitable laser marking machines can mark QR codes, barcodes, data matrix codes, serial numbers, and other machine-readable information on compatible surfaces.

mainEntity.name: Can laser marking be done on plastic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but suitability depends on the type of plastic, its composition, colour, additives, and the laser wavelength. UV laser systems can be suitable for certain specialised plastic-marking applications.
Laser marking can create durable and permanent identification depending on the material, marking method, environmental conditions, and required application.

mainEntity.name: How much does a laser marking machine cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost varies depending on the laser source, power, marking area, machine configuration, automation level, software, and application requirements. Contact Paratech Industries for a machine recommendation and quotation based on your requirements.

mainEntity.name: Does Paratech Industries provide laser marking machines in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paratech Industries manufactures and supplies industrial laser marking solutions for customers in India and supports different manufacturing and industrial applications.
